samples.code: import { Controller, Inject } from '@nestjs/common'; import { MessagePattern, Payload } from '@nestjs/microservices'; import { ClientKafka } from '@nestjs/microservices'; // High-Concurrency Event-Driven Microservice @Controller() export class OrderConsumerController { constructor( @Inject('KAFKA_SERVICE') private readonly kafkaClient: ClientKafka, private readonly dbPool: PostgresConnectionPool ) {} @MessagePattern('order.checkout.v1') async handleOrderEvent(@Payload() data: OrderPayload) { const client = await this.dbPool.connect(); try { await client.query('BEGIN'); const record = await client.query( 'INSERT INTO orders(id, amount, status) VALUES($1, $2, $3) RETURNING *', [data.id, data.amount, 'PROCESSING'] ); await client.query('COMMIT'); this.kafkaClient.emit('order.dispatched', { orderId: record.rows[0].id }); return { status: 'DISPATCHED_TO_PIPELINE', latency: '1.2ms' }; } catch (err) { await client.query('ROLLBACK'); throw err; } } }

samples.code: import Redis from 'ioredis'; // Redis Cluster Distributed Lock & Rate Limiter (Token Bucket) export class DistributedCacheEngine { private cluster: Redis.Cluster; constructor() { this.cluster = new Redis.Cluster([{ host: 'redis-cluster', port: 6379 }]); } async acquireLockAndCache(key: string, ttlMs: number, fetchFn: () => Promise<any>) { const lockKey = `lock:${key}`; const acquired = await this.cluster.set(lockKey, 'LOCKED', 'PX', 3000, 'NX'); if (!acquired) { await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 50)); return this.cluster.get(key); // Cache stampede protection } try { const freshData = await fetchFn(); await this.cluster.set(key, JSON.stringify(freshData), 'PX', ttlMs); return freshData; } finally { await this.cluster.del(lockKey); } } }

samples.code: import asyncio from langchain_google_genai import ChatGoogleGenerativeAI from pgvector.asyncpg import register_vector # Autonomous LLM RAG & Orchestration Engine async def orchestrate_inference(query: str, pool): model = ChatGoogleGenerativeAI(model="gemini-1.5-pro", temperature=0.1) # Retrieve context from PostgreSQL PGVector index async with pool.acquire() as conn: embeddings = await model.aembed_query(query) context = await conn.fetch( "SELECT content FROM knowledge_docs ORDER BY embedding <=> $1 LIMIT 5", embeddings ) response = await model.ainvoke(f"Context: {context}\nTask: {query}") return {"result": response.content, "latency_ms": 18.4}
